// diagnostic

E0754

An implementation of a trait's method reaches an effect outside the trait's `#FX(…)` ceiling or one the cap denies, or its row declares one

What

An implementation of a trait's method reaches an effect outside the trait's `#FX(…)` ceiling or one the cap denies, or its row declares one

Why

`#FX(…)` above a trait bounds every implementation of its methods, in any package and inherited defaults included, through every callee they can reach; a row on an implementation may only narrow it

Fix

Remove the work that needs the effect from the implementation, narrow its row, or widen the trait's `#FX(…)` cap

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0754: tests/ui/effects/trait_cap_binds_body_impl_block_is_e0754.stderr.

Error [jet.TraitCapExceeded]: `text` reaches the `FS.Read` effect, which trait `Source` denies
  --> tests/ui/effects/trait_cap_binds_body_impl_block_is_e0754.jet:7:9
    |
  7 |         text: fn(self) -> String { fs.read(self.path) ?? "" }
    |         ^^^^
  --> tests/ui/effects/trait_cap_binds_body_impl_block_is_e0754.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | #FX(!FS)
    | ^^^^^^^^ trait `Source` is capped here
 Why: The trait's `#FX(…)` cap denies `FS` to every implementation of the trait's methods and every callee it can reach
 Fix: Remove the call that introduces `FS.Read`, or drop `!FS` from the trait's `#FX(…)` cap
 Denial: invocation
 Call chain: text
 Scope chain: trait Source
